transformer_inference.description: Performs transformer-based inference on EHR and lab test data to predict clinical outcomes. Uses multi-modal fusion of text and numerical features.

input.name: ehr_data
input.description: List of Electronic Health Record text entries

input.name: lab_tests
input.description: 2D array of lab test values (samples x features)

output.name: risk_category
output.description: Risk category: LOW, MODERATE, or HIGH

web_search.description: Searches the web using DuckDuckGo to find medical information and clinical evidence related to a query.

input.name: max_results
input.description: Maximum number of search results to return

output.name: results
output.description: List of search results with title, url, and snippet

output.name: reasoning
output.description: Synthesized reasoning based on search results

trajectory_inference.description: Performs single-cell trajectory inference to identify developmental or disease progression pathways in the data.

input.name: data
input.description: Expression or feature matrix (cells/samples x features)

output.name: graph
output.description: Trajectory graph with nodes and edges

output.name: branch_points
output.description: Detected branching points in the trajectory

clustering.description: Performs clustering analysis on data to identify groups or subpopulations.

input.name: n_clusters
input.description: Number of clusters (optional, auto-detected if not specified)

output.name: clusters
output.description: Cluster information including centroids and statistics

output.name: quality_metrics
output.description: Clustering quality metrics like silhouette score

risk_assessment.description: Performs comprehensive risk assessment combining multiple analysis methods.

input.name: assessment_type
input.description: Type of assessment: basic, comprehensive, detailed
